title: Conversation

commands.report: 262 unit tests pass; conversation.test.mjs covers U05/W02/W15 and command authorization

tests: U05 an idle private message is a followup with a persisted correlation
U05 a steer uses the ! prefix and reuses the in-flight turn
U05 /use binds only an authorized session id
W02 a busy session without a unique live turn is a CONFLICT, never a guess
W02 another principal cannot attach to a session owned by someone else
C04 /stop wins and cancels later work on the same session
W15 the command permission table fails closed by role
W15 /quiet is owner-only and only sets quiet on the bound session
W15 /route is read-only and reports the bound session path
a group chat refuses every control path and sends no reply
an explicit /approve REF settles exactly one interaction (no free-text guessing)
